facts.name: Creative
facts.summary: Blender, GIMP, Krita, Inkscape, OBS, darktable, Kdenlive, Ardour and Audacity in one install
facts.description: The Creative set installs the tools for pictures, video, 3D and sound together, each one the version pinned to your WolOS release: Blender, GIMP, Krita, Inkscape, OBS Studio, darktable, Kdenlive, Ardour and Audacity, with colour management and the sound bridge they need. It is the same set as Settings > Modules > Creative.
